turnos.t: How does Ansoff show how risky a growth plan is?

It crosses existing or new products with existing or new markets. Market penetration, selling more of the same to the same customers, is safest. Product development and market development each add one unknown. Diversification adds two, so it's the riskiest.
An e-bike shop opening the same model in a new town: market development. Selling a new subscription to existing customers: product development. Name the strategy and its risk.
